Emporium of Wonderful Ideas is an [[Events|Event]] that allows you to choose a “useless” card from a shop full of… questionable ideas.

This event can appear in Zone 2 or Zone 3.

==Options==
You may choose one of the cards below to add to your deck, or decline the offer. ([[File:ArtifactHardmode.png|20px|link=Hardmode]] [[Hardmode]]: one of the card options is removed at random)
* '''Let’s try Buckshot.'''
** Add a card: [[Buckshot]]
* '''Give me Waltz.'''
** Add a card: [[Waltz]]
* '''How about Bruise?'''
** Add a card: [[Bruise]]
* '''Lightning in a Bottle, please!'''
** Add a card: [[Lightning in a Bottle]]
* '''Yeah, no.'''

==Strategy==
Every card Tooth offers here has a net-zero impact when played on their own, but that doesn’t mean all of them are always useless! For example, [[Buckshot]] does appreciable damage with any amount of [[Overdrive]] or [[Powerdrive]]. For an analysis of these edge cases, see each individual card page.

==Notes==
* The upgraded versions of every card offered here are similarly net-zero in usefulness.
